title: A class of II$_1$ factors without non-trivial crossed product decompositions
summary: We introduce a class of separable II$_1$ factors $M$ admitting no non-trivial crossed product decompositions: $M\not\cong B\rtimes_σG$, for any trace preserving action $G\curvearrowright^σ(B,τ)$ of an infinite countable group $G$ on a tracial von Neumann algebra $(B,τ)$. These provide the first examples of II$_1$ factors that do not arise as crossed products of noncommutative dynamical systems.
